ctx.x: But I was very well acquainted with George Bakke. Sure. He was bumming all the while. He came back together first, me, George Bakke. I knew all of his people. And we went to the meeting. I taken him over in my car to the meeting. I taken Old Man Humphrey, Piku, no, yeah, Piku, George Bakke, myself, and Ernest Trapani. He was a great drummer also.
I didn't get to know him, but he... He died lately. He worked at that same bar room that George's sister had on. Yeah, that's it.
